M
Good morning, Riverside Sports Centre. How can I help you?
F
Hi. I'd like to book a badminton court for this Saturday, please.
M
Of course. What time were you thinking of?
F
Around ten in the morning, if possible.
M
Let me check. Ten o'clock is taken, I'm afraid, but there's a court free at eleven thirty.
F
Eleven thirty is fine. How long can we have it for?
M
Courts are booked by the hour, so until half past twelve. It's eight pounds fifty for members and twelve pounds for non-members.
F
I'm not a member yet. Is it worth joining?
M
If you play every week, yes. Membership is forty pounds a year, and you also get ten per cent off in the cafe.
F
That sounds good. I'll think about it. Can I take the booking now anyway?
M
Sure. Could I have your surname, please?
F
It's Henderson. H, E, N, D, E, R, S, O, N.
M
Thank you. And a phone number?
F
Oh seven seven, double four, five one, two nine three.
M
Lovely. Please arrive fifteen minutes early, and bring your own rackets. We only have a few to borrow.
